# std::ipc

Module file: `stdlib/std/ipc.mla`

System IPC helpers. The backend exposes named pipes and local stream sockets:
- Unix-like platforms use FIFO paths created with `mkfifo`.
- Windows uses native named pipes; simple names expand to `\\.\pipe\<name>`.
- Local sockets use Unix-domain stream sockets on Unix-like platforms and
  Winsock `AF_UNIX` on supported Windows versions.

Examples:
- `examples/std_ipc_named_pipe_demo.mla`
- `examples/std_ipc_local_socket_demo.mla`
